notes.title: Steam Strategy Fest Demo Hotfix 0.2.2
notes.content:
[b]Hello survivors![/b]

We're back with another hot fix that addresses more balance issues and bugs!

We are currently working on identifying the root cause of why the in-game survey is slowing down or crashing for some folks. Feel free to hop into our discord to help us bug bash! In the meantime we've made all survey questions optional to submit and [b]you can also access the survey directly here: 

[/b]https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1fhcj0IjPw0coYKTogAoVbbwINxyWByCRJHj14HqKZaI/


Your feedback means a lot to us, including what you liked and didn't like plus any bugs or issues you experienced during your playthrough really helps us out. If you get a chance to submit a survey response we would be really grateful! Join our Discord channel here!: 

https://discord.com/invite/2d9Ag6DTAe


Also since we didn't get an opportunity yet to add a new tutorial tip please keep in mind that ranged weapons [b]do not need to be reloaded![/b] If the weapon has durability and you have the right ammunition type in your inventory then you are all set!

[h3]Patch Notes:[/h3]
[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] All survey questions are now optional
[*] Office chairs now offer half cover
[*] Sped up enemy death fade out
[*] Adjusted or rewrote descriptions for certain enemies and abilities
[*] Slightly increased XP grants for stealth, looting, and enemies killed
[*] Equipment will automatically be equipped when looted if the teammate has an open equipment slot
[*] Made 0 AP in the action bar slightly more obvious (will turn red when at 0)
[*] Teammates will be healed to full health upon returning to the caravan
[*] Pressing Level Up icon on a teammate in the terminal will now bring up that teammate's skill tree
[*] Noise amounts for mines, grenades, and ranged weapons adjusted
[*] Make it easier to see enemy vision cones + visible tiles when hovered
[*] Enemies will no longer get an attack of opportunity if blocked by the player while moving
[*] Zombies can no longer become enraged (extra movement + damage) until they have taken damage
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed incorrect starting tiles in hospital room
[*] Adjusted walk animation for teammate Gregor
[*] Fixed "HEALING" stat value popup
[*] Fixed Weapon Swap hotkey showing even when UI hotkeys are disabled
[*] Fixed broken Cloak ability behavior
[*] Prevented Sprint ability from going through inner walls
[*] Fixed issue with teammate taking incorrect damage when destroying mines with a ranged weapon
[*] Adjusted Mind Control ability behavior
[*] More consistent Turret behavior when using Turret Hacking ability
[*] Locksmith now works correctly for locked doors
[*] Fixed loot not fully loading when opening a safe with the Locksmith ability
[*] Fixed bug preventing Nightingale Skull equipment from working if at 0 AP
[*] Fixed enemy pathing issues that would cause enemies to occupy the same tile
[*] Prevent Parasite from resurrecting bodies if killed by mine next to body
[*] Adjusted and fix issues relating to Ranged Scavenger's Overwatch ability
[*] Adjusted enemy target selection when enemy is Mind Controlled
[*] Fixed several crashes and soft locks (we are still working on identifying more, please helps us if you encounter one by hopping into our Discord!)
[/list]
A friendly reminder that this is a [b]limited time demo for Strategy Fest[/b] so remember to play soon since the [b]demo will be coming down in the next few days![/b]

notes.title: Steam Strategy Fest Demo Hotfix 0.2.1
notes.content:
Hello survivors!

We have been blown away by the feedback and support we've received so far and are thrilled to see folks playing and enjoying the demo!

We've identified a number of bugs, balance changes, and stability improvements that we want to make and are planning to have a larger demo patch out later this week.

For now we've pushed a hotfix that adds some smaller quality of life and bug fixes:

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Additional way to view safe tutorial, will now appear when attempting to open a locked safe
[*] Slightly increased the drop rate of blueprints and relics
[*] Made damage and noise stat popups more clear by adding text labels
[*] Small UI change to enemy awareness bar to make it more clear when they will hear noise
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fix some layering issues on Hospital levels
[*] Remove inaccessible loot container from Residential level
[*] Prevent ability/action tooltips from staying on screen after ending turn
[*] Lower shrieker sound effect volume for shriek and death
[*] Show correct noise amount for throwables in hover tooltip
[/list]

Once again thanks for playing and we'll be back with more updates soon!

notes.title: Steam Strategy Fest Demo Now Live!
notes.content:
[b]The Outer Zone: Survival Tactics Demo now live as part of Steam Strategy Fest![/b]

[b]As part of the festival we have a limited time demo running from August 28th to September 4th![/b]

We've been working hard on adding new locations, mechanics, enemies, and classes, with lots more to come! We would love any feedback or thoughts on what could be improved!

[b]The demo focuses on scavenging gameplay and features:[/b]
[list]
[*] 3 unique classes
[*] 3 locations - Residential, Hospital, and Office
[*] Over 100 unique levels
[*] 7 enemy types
[*] and more!
[/list]
Please fill out the in-game survey if you get a chance, your feedback will be crucial to help shape the game and make it the best experience possible!

Join us in our [url=https://discord.gg/2d9Ag6DTAe]Discord [/url]to share your thoughts directly with us!
